requires: The repository root contains pyproject.toml, the MathHead package, the accepted environment profile manifest, pytest tests, MCP registration, and the declared documentation example manifest.
Dynamic collection runs only in a bootstrapped development or documentation profile with the pinned pytest and product dependencies available.
Every published executable result example has a unique repository-stable example ID, an exact source locator, one declared ENV-002 profile, and at least one exact pytest node ID.
ensures: src/mathhead/_version.py contains the sole editable package SemVer literal; mathhead.__version__, build metadata, installed metadata, CLI version output, changelog validation, and generated facts resolve from it.
pyproject.toml declares dynamic version loading through the pinned Hatch build backend and contains no second package version literal.

The generated project-facts artifact reports the exact package version, full MCP tool count, pytest collection count, profile order, product Python matrix, and generation schema from live repository sources.
Check mode compares regenerated canonical UTF-8 content with committed artifacts and returns nonzero on any version, test-count, tool-count, profile, README, or example-manifest drift.
README numeric package-version, collected-test, MCP-tool, and governed-profile claims occur only in generator-owned regions or are derived from the generated artifact.

Every executable example validator is selected by its declared profile and runs the exact published command or API behavior; missing, deselected, skipped, failed, or timed-out validators cannot make the examples gate green.
Setup-only, external-client, publication, and long-running server snippets are not mislabeled executable examples and require an explicit non-executable classification and reason.
Generated output is deterministic, sorted, path-relative, and contains no clock, checkout path, runner identity, random value, or elapsed timing.
raises: No Python exception crosses the CLI boundary for malformed metadata, missing files, collection failure, MCP registration failure, stale output, or example ownership drift.
Unknown manifest fields, duplicate example IDs or locators, unsupported profiles, missing validator node IDs, ambiguous version literals, and unclassified executable fences fail closed.
Programmer defects may produce a traceback only in explicit debug mode.

effects.filesystem: check mode is read-only except tool-owned caches; update mode may replace only docs/project-facts.json and explicitly delimited generator-owned README regions
effects.process: may run bounded pytest collection, exact example validators, MCP tool enumeration, build metadata checks, and installed CLI version smoke commands
effects.network: none after the selected ENV-002 profile has been bootstrapped
effects.repository: never edits PLAN, TODO, PROGRESS, accepted contracts, frozen baseline evidence, source examples, or files outside declared generated outputs

determinism.version: one literal in src/mathhead/_version.py is parsed without importing build tooling
determinism.tests: pytest node IDs are collected under the pinned docs profile, sorted, and counted after profile ownership hooks run
determinism.tools: the full unfiltered MCP registry is enumerated and tool names are sorted before counting or serialization
determinism.examples: strict TOML entries and source directives are sorted by stable example ID and use repository-relative paths
determinism.serialization: canonical JSON uses UTF-8, sorted keys, stable separators, and a trailing newline

budget.example_validator_seconds: the declared ENV-002 profile and global 30-second per-test limit apply
budget.cancellation: terminate then kill the active child, wait for reaping, and return a distinct nonzero result

epistemics.current: all generated facts equal live sources and every declared executable example validator passed in its selected profile
epistemics.stale: a generated claim differs from its live source or an executable example changed without regeneration
epistemics.invalid: metadata or example ownership is malformed, incomplete, ambiguous, or outside the accepted schema
epistemics.not_run: facts were read or described without live regeneration; never equivalent to current

invariants: There is exactly one editable package SemVer literal in the repository metadata boundary.
Package import, wheel metadata, installed metadata, CLI output, changelog entry, and generated facts agree on the same SemVer.
Tool and test counts are outputs of live enumeration, never hand-maintained constants used as current-status claims.
The frozen v1 MCP minimum remains a compatibility floor and is not confused with the generated current full-tool count.
Every published executable result example belongs to exactly one declared profile and every manifest validator node ID exists.
No generated claim reports a red, skipped, missing, unsupported, or timed-out validator as green.
Immutable accepted contracts and legacy baseline evidence remain byte-identical.
